'''Galloping with Ponyta''' (Chinese: '''{{lang|zh-cmn-Hans-CN|穿越风雪，奔赴春光～元宵喜乐时，和小火马一起闪耀新年吧！}}''' ''Braving the Snowstorm, Dashing towards Springtime ~ In Celebration of Lantern Festival, Let's Shine in the New Year with Ponyta!''; Japanese: '''ポニータと駆ける''' ''Galloping with Ponyta'') is a one-minute {{pkmn|animation|animated}} short based on the {{wp|Lantern Festival|Year of the Horse}}. It was released on Weibo, Douyin, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, and Kuaishou in {{pmin|mainland China}} on March 3, 2026, and on the {{pmin|Japan}}ese and English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channels on March 6, 2026.
